quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on the killer mentality of legendary players
quotes.excerpt: I've had this feeling with very specific players. I've never met Michael Jordan, I've shaken his hand.
quotes.quote: I've had this feeling with very specific players. I've never met Michael Jordan, I've shaken his hand, but I've had the same feeling. I had it with Kobe Bryant, Kevin Garnett, and you. A feeling of like a killer mentality.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on Kevin Durant's impact and inspiration
quotes.excerpt: I'm not here without you. You inspire me. You impact my life. I wanted to be like you.
quotes.quote: I went to him and I talked to him and I said, 'Hey man, I'm not here without you. You inspire me. You impact my life. I wanted to be like you.' The way you play, the way you carry yourself, the greatness that you have, the things that you've accomplished in your career, I looked up to all of those things and it was my duty to say that, to take that off my chest.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Giannis's status as a top player
quotes.excerpt: I would ever be sitting here looking at a guy that I believe to be one of the top three players.
quotes.quote: I didn't think that I would ever be sitting here looking at a guy that I believe to be one of the top three players on the planet Earth. That's what he is. And I didn't know enough about him to know what level of appreciation I feel all of us should have for him. I love his competitive fervor. I love the fact that he's not trying to befriend the opponent. I love the fact that he has the attitude that I'm coming for everybody. You be ready because I'm going to be ready.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on the honor of representing Greece
quotes.excerpt: It's an honor to represent the national team. It's a bigger honor to be the first black flag bearer.
quotes.quote: It's an honor to represent the national team. It's a bigger honor to be the first black flag bearer for Greece, for the rest of the athletes. I didn't know this, but how many athletes in Greece look up to me? It's insane. We talk about professional athletes, we talk about gold medalist athletes, they're like, 'Man, your story is so inspiring, we look up to you.' The way you work hard, the approach you have, we just want to follow your footsteps.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on why he is the best player
quotes.excerpt: The next guy is not willing to do what I'm willing to do.
quotes.quote: If somebody asks me, 'Why you, Giannis? Why not the next guy?' I know the answer. The next guy is not willing to do what I'm willing to do. Why you, why are you Nikos Galis? Why you got to the top of the world? Why you are the best? Why?

quotes.speaker: Khris Middleton
quotes.summary_phrase: Khris Middleton on his first impression of Giannis
quotes.excerpt: Who is this tall skinny kid? The guy is taller than me. He's skinny, he's like my pinky.
quotes.quote: Who is this tall skinny kid? The guy is taller than me. For one, he's skinny, he's like my pinky. John Henson might have been a shot to the hook. John Henson was bigger than him at the time. I'm just like, wait a second, this guy plays my position and he's from Greece, Europe, the top pick. All right, this is the guy I'm going to have to duke it out with this year to at least make the team or get to my next contract or to even break the rotation.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on his connection with Khris Middleton
quotes.excerpt: I've scored 20,000 points, 10,000 points from Khris.
quotes.quote: My best connection I've had in basketball in general. I've scored 20,000 points, 10,000 points from Khris. I'm going to tell my grandkids that, I'm going to tell my kids that, I'm going to tell the media that. It's a fact. I've been with Khris for 11 years. We've been through a lot. We've been through the mud together.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on the lack of ego between him and Khris
quotes.excerpt: We are workers and we never had this selfish thing. We always did what was best for the team.
quotes.quote: We are workers and we never had this selfish thing. We always did what was best for the team. And down the stretch, it was easy. He was the best closer in basketball that year. So it was very easy for me. I wanted to win the game.
